scope: Estimated finite wheel-output torque hypothesis for the articulated CAD load distribution; not verified hardware capacity

derivation.wheel_load_formula: N_est = wheel_mass_kg*g - transmitted_joint_force_world_z in the stable 12..13s tail; ignores acceleration and other wheel-body contact, so is a simulation estimate, not a tire sensor measurement
derivation.gain_selection: Keep P12, I4, D0 and integral-output clamp +/-1Nm exactly. Change only the common finite output-effort bound from4 to6.5Nm, including joint limit, actuator estimate and controller command clamp. Keep mu=.6, geometry, inertia, suspension, masks, timestep and all physical acceptance thresholds.
derivation.hardware_caveat: 6.5Nm is an estimated simulation hypothesis. No measured motor torque-speed curve, thermal capacity or gearbox capacity supports a hardware claim. Full15s commissioning on the corrected CAD remains required before any harvest admission.
